questions.question: Why use event time for analytical windows?
options: Processing delay should not assign an event to the wrong real-world period
It guarantees ordering across all partitions
questions.explanation: Event time represents when the source event happened.

questions.question: What does a watermark express?
options: Estimated event-time completeness and how long to wait for late events
questions.explanation: Watermarks drive when windows can be considered complete.

questions.question: What makes replay safe for a business action?
options: Stable IDs and idempotent or transactional sinks
questions.explanation: Framework recovery alone cannot prevent duplicate external effects.

questions.question: During a model outage, what should a well-isolated stream do?
options: Continue durable event and feature processing while decisions fall back or abstain
questions.explanation: Separating durable data flow from model availability simplifies recovery.
